notes: 15 cards: 4 instrument-to-family cards (cello, oboe, tuba, xylophone), 1 family-to-sound-production card, 3 playing-technique terms (arco, double stopping, con sordino), 1 timbre-description card, 4 technology cards (sampler, reverb, DAW, distortion), plus 2 set-work or synonym cards (sonority, the synthesised African percussion sounds). Timbre adjective lists were not turned into cards because each would be an enumeration. Dropped phasing, panning and falsetto to stay inside 15.
